contextHint: Add extra entry details to the prompt to improve suggestions.
languagesHint: Send each entry's finished translations in the selected languages as extra context.
skipCategoriesHint: Entries carrying any of these categories are left out of the request entirely.
ignoreGlossariesHint: Selected glossaries' terms are treated as already-known terminology: for glossary generation they're sent as already known so the model doesn't re-suggest them; for category generation, entries matching those terms are left out of the request entirely.
